vectors.description: INVALID — kid prefix does not match envelope 'from' field. 'from' is 'agent:acme.echo-client' but kid is 'agent:arsialabs.demo.risk-assessor#key1' (declaring a different agent). The signature is mathematically valid over the canonical bytes using Keypair B, but per Core §5.2 JWKS resolution uses the agent in 'from' — the receiver fetches echo-client's JWKS, does not find the risk-assessor kid, and rejects the message with 'unauthorized'. No crypto block because the point is the kid↔from binding violation.
